composite.name: QB composite
composite.about: Our all-round passing grade: EPA per dropback, accuracy, sack avoidance and turnovers blended into a forecast of next season's EPA per dropback.

value.name: Gridiron Value (GVAR)
value.about: Our value above a replacement-level player at the same position, per game and in total, from the plays the player is credited with.

kicking.name: Expected kicking model
kicking.about: Field goals, points and net punting over what an average kicker or punter would manage on the same attempts.

fourth.name: Fourth-down model
fourth.about: Our go / kick / punt advice from the win-probability model, and how often a team goes when it says go.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Points per game better than average, split into offence and defence, from our game model.

composite: Our all-round passing grade: EPA per dropback, accuracy, sack avoidance and turnovers blended into a forecast of next season's EPA per dropback.
epa_db: Expected points added per dropback, counting sacks and scrambles.
success: Share of dropbacks that gain expected points (r 0.88 with EPA per dropback).
cpoe: Completion percentage over expected: completions above what our model expects for those throws.
sack_rate: Sacks per dropback; the most quarterback-driven part of pass protection.
int_rate: Interceptions per pass attempt. Very noisy year to year: read it with the sample size.
pressure_rate: Share of dropbacks under pressure (line, play design and the quarterback's own hold time).
adot: Air yards per attempt: how far downfield the passes go (style, not quality).
ttt: Next Gen Stats average time from snap to throw (2016 onward).
scramble_rate: Scrambles per dropback: how often the quarterback escapes and runs (style).
anya: Adjusted net yards per attempt (touchdowns, interceptions and sacks included).
gvar_pg: Gridiron Value above a replacement back per game: rushing and receiving combined (value.json).
deep_rate: Share of attempts 20+ air yards downfield.
aggressiveness: Next Gen Stats share of throws into tight windows.
twp_rate: FTN-charted interception-worthy throws per attempt (2022 onward).
epa_clean: EPA per dropback when not pressured.
pa_rate: Share of dropbacks with play action (FTN, 2022 onward).
epa_play: EPA per dropback or designed run (r 0.99 with EPA per dropback).
value: Season total of expected points credited to the player, adjusted for opponent and cast.
ryoe: Yards per carry beyond what our model expects from the blocking, box and down and distance.
rush_success: Share of carries that gain expected points.
explosive: Share of carries gaining 10+ yards; the most stable rushing efficiency number.
rush_epa: Expected points added per designed run.
stuff_rate: Share of carries stopped for no gain or a loss.
target_share: Share of the team's pass attempts thrown to the player in the games played: the role in the passing game.
ypc: Rushing yards per carry (r 0.95 with RYOE).
rec_epa_tgt: Expected points added per target: what the offence gains when the player is the target.
box8: Next Gen Stats share of carries against eight or more in the box (context). Null in every payload today (NGS loader bug).
yptpa: Receiving yards per team pass attempt in the games played: a route-free stand-in for yards per route run.
croe: Catches above what our completion model expects for these targets (depth, coverage, pressure).
yac_rec: Yards after the catch per reception.
yacoe: Yards after the catch beyond our expected-YAC model (r 0.89 with YAC per reception, less stable).
air_share: Share of the team's intended air yards in the games played.
wopr: 1.5 x target share + 0.7 x air-yards share (r 0.96 with target share).
catch_rate: Receptions per target (driven by depth of target; CROE adjusts for it).
drop_rate: FTN drops per catchable target (2022 onward). Unstable (r 0.15).
contested_rate: FTN contested targets caught (2022 onward). Unstable (r 0.07).
separation: Next Gen Stats separation at the catch point. Null in every payload today (NGS loader bug).
cushion: Next Gen Stats cushion at the snap. Null in every payload today (NGS loader bug).
yprr: Receiving yards per dropback on the field (participation, 2016-2025 only; not available in-season).
tprr: Targets per dropback on the field (participation, 2016-2025 only).
pressures_pg: Sacks and quarterback hits per game: the steadiest individual pass-rush number in the data.
tfl_pg: Tackles behind the line per game.
splash_pg: Sacks, takeaways, forced fumbles, pass break-ups and tackles for loss per game.
tackles_pg: Solo and assisted tackles per game (involvement, not quality).
ff_pg: Forced fumbles per game. Unstable (r about 0.2).
sacks_pg: Sacks per game (r 0.86-0.88 with sacks + hits per game, less stable).
pd_pg: Passes broken up or intercepted per game (batted balls for linemen).
pass_rush_rate: Sacks and QB hits per opponent dropback on the field (participation, 2016-2025 only).
tfl_run: Tackles for loss per opponent run on the field (participation, 2016-2025 only).
ints_pg: Interceptions per game. Mostly luck from one season to the next.
ball_cov: Passes defensed and interceptions per opponent dropback on the field (participation, 2016-2025 only).
fg_oe: Field goals made minus what our model expects from the distances and conditions faced (season total).
fg_pct: Field goals made per attempt (ignores distance; r 0.86 with FG over expected, less stable).
fg_50_pct: Field goals of 50+ yards made per attempt.
avg_dist: Average distance of field-goal tries (how far the coach trusts the kicker).
pts_oe: 3 x field goals over expected + extra points over expected (r 0.98 with FG over expected).
epa_punt: Expected points gained for the punting team per punt (field position flipped, returns included).
net: Punt distance less return yards and 20 yards for each touchback.
gross: Average punt distance (the most stable punting number).
inside20: Share of punts downed or returned inside the 20.
net_oe: Field position over expected per punt from our punt model. Sign is inverted in today's payload (higher = worse); hide until fixed.

rating: Points per game better than an average team on a neutral field (our team-strength model).
off_rating: Offensive points per game above average.
def_rating: Defensive points per game above average (positive = better).
off_epa: Opponent-adjusted expected points added per offensive play.
def_epa: Opponent-adjusted expected points allowed per play.
st_epa_g: Net expected points per game on kicks, punts and returns.
off_pass_epa: Opponent-adjusted EPA per dropback: the most stable and predictive unit number.
off_success: Share of plays that gain expected points.
pressure_allowed: Share of dropbacks under pressure (the offensive line and quarterback together).
proe_neutral: How much more often they pass than expected on early downs in close games (style).
motion_rate: Pre-snap motion per play (FTN, 2022 onward; style).
go_rate_rec: Share of fourth downs our model says to go for where they went.
def_rush_epa: Opponent-adjusted EPA allowed per designed run.
def_success: Share of opponent plays that gain expected points.
blitz_rate: Dropbacks with five or more rushers or any blitzer (FTN, 2022 onward; style).
